Summarize a burndown object

Source: R/burndown.R
summary-burndown-method.Rd

Print a summary of a burndown dataset.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'burndown'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A burndown object.

...

ignored.

See also

Other things related to burndown data: as.burndown(), burndown, burndown-class, plot,burndown-method, read.burndown()

Author

Dan Kelley

Examples

library(plan)
data(burndown)
summary(burndown)
